title: CGUSB-ST4 / NYX-101 ST4 DEC response is inverted relative to direct NYX guiding away from pole on east side.
summary: At DEC +70 degrees, unchanged east side and R1, adapter code 0 changes DEC about -14.552 arcsec and code 1 about +14.530 arcsec for 2 s, opposite to PHD2 nominal N/S and direct NYX n/s. Next: isolate adapter firmware, ST4 cable/pinout and NYX configuration before selecting remediation; owner requires current driver mapping unchanged.
evidence: verification.md and orientation-probe.jsonl in task 20261024095945-ac63-verify-cgusbst4-dec-orientation; two repeats each of direct n/s and numeric 0/1, matched idle interval, stable pier side E; original park/settings restored.
